headline: Asia-Pacific Stock Markets Mostly Declined on Monday
summary: Most major Asia-Pacific stock indices declined on Monday, with South Korea's KOSPI falling 3.1%.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main benchmark index, and it is heavily weighted toward large technology and industrial companies.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The KOSPI fell 3.1%, the largest decline cited among regional indices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The report gives no specific cause for the regional sell-off, only the index moves.
